phase_prompt.label: Phase 1: The Unique Instance
phase_prompt.summary: The beast is observed in a state of high-fidelity stability, a singular creature unlike any other in the environment, showcasing the timeline's material palette.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A massive, solitary creature standing still in a flat, desolate landscape. The beast has a unique anatomy, a blend of heavy mammal and crystalline reptile, with scales made of dark data-glass and matte black bone. The lighting is cold and natural, emphasizing the hyper-realistic textures of its weathered hide. The background features the faint grid of the sky dome. The mood is somber and majestic. 8k resolution, photorealistic render, cinematic composition.
